column1: # EN: Recheck on the images (20 Oct 2026) of the 19 corrections of second/review_f218v_f219r.tsv by two other models, OpenAI Codex (codex-cli 0.163.0-alpha.10.2, default model) and Claude Sonnet. Each was shown the line images, the specimen sheet and the two readings (before / after the correction, in random order as A/B), no values. "both after" = both chose the corrected reading; "split" = they disagreed or one could not tell; "both before" = both chose the earlier reading (none).
# 見直しで直した19か所を、別の2つのモデル（OpenAI Codex と Claude Sonnet）に画像で確かめ直させた結果（2026-10-20）。行画像・見本表・2つの読み（直す前と後。A・B の順は乱数）だけを渡し、値は渡していない。
